content: KIS Open API: access token valid ~24h, must be reused not re-issued per call; rate limit ~20 calls/sec (1s window); paper trading (모의투자) has LOWER REST limits than real. Real domain openapi.koreainvestment.com:9443, paper domain openapivts.koreainvestment.com:29443 — DIFFERENT host AND port, and appkey/appsecret differ between mock and real. Order rejections occur on rate-limit-exceeded and on invalid params/market hours. Corroborated by official portal + multiple community blogs.
